interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 7.6 and an ISUP grade group 3 Gleason pattern on the prostatectomy specimen. Contributing to risk are positive surgical margins and documented extraprostatic extension (pT3a). Countervailing findings include no seminal vesicle invasion and absent lymphovascular invasion. The absence of removed lymph nodes widens uncertainty regarding nodal status, as pNx is not equivalent to pN0. Biopsy-to-prostatectomy differences cannot be assessed because the biopsy Gleason pattern and ISUP report are missing. Future prognosis assessment would benefit significantly from postoperative PSA levels and their subsequent trajectory. The fixed estimated horizon is 51.41 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 30.85–71.97 months; its coverage has not been validated.
